work_packages.title: Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state
work_packages.description: Build and calibrate the diagnostic branch for tomato (RQ1): acquire and harmonise Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical and secured PlanetScope (RQ8) with meteorological (ERA5 reanalysis) and field-observation data; implement Route B, the homogeneous-patch proxy (RQ2), within an architecture that also defines Route A (direct one-step probabilistic fusion via a Bayesian hierarchical model / Gaussian process), to estimate the latent field state (root-zone soil moisture and crop water status, RQ3) as a posterior with honest uncertainty.

work_packages.title: Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration
work_packages.description: Build the prognostic branch and decision engine: uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration retaining an honest parameter posterior; counterfactual irrigation simulation over weather ensembles; water-use-efficiency-based decision recommendation under uncertainty (RQ6). Integrate diagnosis and decision into a standalone research demonstrator (web MVP) targeting a research prototype, TRL 3-4 (RQ10).
work_packages.note: The decision objective is water-use efficiency (RQ6); the vault's objective-function machinery is instantiated with WUE. The uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration is the project's vault-grounded methodology, not attributed to the fellow.

work_packages.title: Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration
work_packages.description: Design and run the validation protocol on Hungarian tomato farms accessed via the associated partner AgroVIR: collect non-destructive physiological ground truth (RQ4: chlorophyll fluorescence, stomatal conductance, canopy/leaf temperature, spectral reflectance), assess uncertainty calibration (RQ5: 90% prediction intervals contain the truth about 90% of the time), define pilot success as the RQ5 target met on the validation set (RQ7), and test Route B's patch-covariation assumption via a co-located seasonal campaign measuring the target crop and the proxy patch simultaneously (RQ9), including the control-stand variant.
work_packages.note: The fellow's non-destructive plant-stress-physiology expertise is the ground-truth strength. Coherence caveat (Inferred): the RQ4 non-destructive measures validate the crop-water-status component of the target state directly and root-zone soil moisture only indirectly; no soil-moisture sensor plan is fabricated.
work_packages.provenance_detail: source_grounded (methodology) + operator_confirmed (RQ4/RQ5/RQ7/RQ9; field sites via AgroVIR)

work_packages.title: Training, supervision and two-way transfer of knowledge
work_packages.description: MSCA-PF structural work package for the researcher's training (scientific, management, transferable skills), supervision, and two-way transfer of knowledge between researcher and host. Content: a Career Development Plan prepared jointly by supervisor and fellow and submitted as a project deliverable at the start of the action, then reviewed and updated during the fellowship; structured transferable-skills training covering the MSCA-PF mandatory dimensions - digital and AI skills (including responsible use of generative AI in remote-sensing and crop-water modelling and scientific coding), knowledge valorisation, innovation and entrepreneurship, research integrity, and open science / FAIR data stewardship; supervision by Dr. András Jung through regular research reviews in the host's geoinformatics and remote-sensing group; and two-way transfer of knowledge - the fellow contributes plant-physiology and non-destructive stress-phenotyping expertise (biological ground truth), and takes up the host's geoinformatics, remote-sensing and hyperspectral/multisensor-fusion methods and infrastructure. Specific quantitative training/career targets are not asserted (none operator-provided) and are to be set in the Career Development Plan.
work_packages.note: The WP exists by MSCA-PF instrument structure (Excellence 1.3); its content is now grounded in the operator-confirmed identity spine and the real two-way transfer. No fellow-specific quantitative figures are invented.
work_packages.provenance_detail: operator_confirmed (two-way transfer; real fellow/supervisor/host) + instrument_requirement (Excellence 1.3; CDP as a start-of-action deliverable; mandatory training dimensions)

work_packages.description: Open-science dissemination (open-access publications, open data/models, DMP by month 6), exploitation logic around the standalone research demonstrator, communication to relevant audiences (the host's geoinformatics and remote-sensing community, and Hungarian tomato growers reached via the associated partner AgroVIR), and lightweight project management, coordination and ethics oversight.
